strategy: 先按前置条件安装并通读 skill threejs-scene-setup，规则、数字和检查以它为准；其他游戏开发 skill 不要预装。
Use on "Failed to resolve module specifier three", a black canvas or nothing animating.
Workflow: Read `three` from `package.json` or the import map; Resolve `three` and `three/addons/`; Create the scene, camera and renderer; Prove the pipeline with an unlit mesh first.
